BiblicalUsage: ʻeryâh means nudity. Most of its 6 occurrences are in Ezekiel. It is a plain word, and that plainness is the point: Scripture does not dress it up.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻeryâh matters because it names something Scripture keeps returning to. It shapes how I hear those verses, and I think it should shape how you hear them too.
